translations.web: Don’t be too wicked, neither be foolish. Why should you die before your time?
translations.bsb: Do not be excessively wicked, and do not be a fool. Why should you die before your time?
translations.kjv: Be not over much wicked, neither be thou foolish: why shouldest thou die before thy time?
translations.asv: Be not overmuch wicked, neither be thou foolish: why shouldest thou die before thy time?
